headline: ComEd Files Four-Year Grid Plan to Sustain Reliability, Maintain Affordability and Adapt to Rising Energy Demands
summary: CHICAGO, January 17, 2026--ComEd today presented to the Illinois Commerce Commission (ICC) its second multi-year grid plan (MYGP) containing ComEd’s plans for critical investments to the grid in years 2028-2031. headline: ComEd Offering $515,000 in Grants to Support Community Programs Across Northern Illinois
summary: CHICAGO, January 12, 2026--ComEd is now accepting grant applications for three of its Power for Good Grant Programs.
